title: Operations Analyst
jobDescription: Role summary: Keep AR Calling and denial workflows moving with speed and accuracy as an Operations Analyst in Chennai, India (Hybrid). You’ll manage day-to-day AR calling activities and support denial management within RCM operations to improve outcomes and operational consistency. This position will report to the Operations Manager. Team summary: The operations team owns and executes critical workflow components of athenahealth. Conduct AR calling activities to support timely patient or payer follow-up as required by workflow standards. Manage denial-related work by identifying denial causes and ensuring appropriate next steps are taken within defined processes. Review RCM documentation and transaction details to confirm accuracy, completeness, and adherence to policy. Update work queues and operational systems with accurate statuses, notes, and outcomes to maintain audit-ready records. Analyze trends in AR calling and denials to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities. Coordinate with internal partners to resolve escalations and ensure consistent handling of denial cases. Ensure quality and compliance by following SOPs and established denial/RCM handling guidelines. Report daily/weekly activity metrics and provide clear summaries of progress, blockers, and next actions. Use AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity and learning by applying AI-assisted summaries or pattern checks to support routine AR calling and denial investigation—while keeping responsibility for validation and final operational decisions. Support special projects related to AR Calling and denial workflow optimization. Assist with knowledge base updates by documenting common denial reasons and resolution guidance. Participate in operational reviews and feedback sessions to improve process adherence. Help train or mentor peers on workflow steps and quality expectations as needed. Perform additional RCM operational tasks assigned by the team to meet coverage requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by proposing process refinements based on observed outcomes. Expected Education & Experience . 2–4 years of experience in healthcare operations, RCM, or related claims/AR workflows. Strong proficiency in MS office tools (Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word etc. ). Practical experience with AR Calling and day-to-day AR follow-up activities. Experience with denial management, including reviewing denial details and progressing cases appropriately. Working knowledge of RCM concepts and standard operational workflows. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation. Comfort working with operational systems and work queues for status tracking and case updates. Ability to work effectively to SOPs and quality standards in a time-sensitive environment.

title: Product Support Analyst
jobDescription: Role summary: Resolve customer and production issues for athenahealth’s interoperability network by combining technical support skills with clear communication as a Product Support Analyst in Chennai, India. You will support interface and workflow stability, troubleshoot problems, and use your capability to help investigate and validate production data. You will report to the Integration Product / Connectivity Support Manager. The Product Support Analyst supports workflows and projects that improve the efficiency and growth of athenahealth’s interoperability network, often referred to as the backbone. This network enables the transmission of healthcare documents—including lab results, imaging results, patient demographics, charges, appointments, and prescriptions—between athenahealth, clients, and trading partners. In this role, you will maintain relationships with interface vendors, participate in production support activities as assigned, and collaborate with internal teams across different geographies as required. You will work closely with the E Integration Product / Connectivity Support Manager in Chennai to help ensure reliable interoperability outcomes. Provide technical support by investigating reported issues across interfaces and production workflows. Troubleshoot interface and data flow problems using logs, diagnostic outputs, and established support procedures. Communicate status updates, findings, and next steps clearly to internal stakeholders and vendors when applicable. Analyze production data to identify symptoms, patterns, and likely root causes. Document investigation steps, results, and resolutions in required support records and knowledge bases. Coordinate with interface vendors to gather information, validate fixes, and confirm successful outcomes. Monitor issue queues and work assignments to ensure timely handling and appropriate escalation. Apply AI-enabled support tools to improve productivity by using AI-assisted summarization of incident details, faster extraction of key troubleshooting signals from logs, and learning updated AI workflows as they become available—while maintaining accurate human verification against technical evidence and SOPs. Assist with root-cause follow-ups and prevention plans for recurring interface issues. Support testing activities for interface changes, including validating outcomes and documenting results. Contribute to creation or updates of interface troubleshooting guides and escalation procedures. Participate in production readiness activities (e.g., knowledge checks, handoff preparation, standard work updates). Review incident trends to recommend improvements to monitoring, documentation, or support workflows. Help ensure consistent data handling and adherence to operational support standards. Support cross-team investigations involving multiple systems or dependencies. 1–3 years of experience in technical support, production support, integrations, or a related technology operations role. Strong technical support background with experience troubleshooting production or interface issues. Good communication skills for coordinating incident details, updates, and resolutions. SQL experience for querying and analyzing production or troubleshooting-related datasets. Familiarity with interoperability concepts (e.g., interfaces, EDI/healthcare data exchange workflows) is helpful. Ability to work with logs, troubleshoot systematically, and document findings accurately. Comfort working in a hybrid environment based in Chennai, India. Willingness to follow established support procedures and escalation paths. Expected Education & Experience .

title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
jobDescription: This role is responsible for driving reliability, observability, automation, and operational readiness across systems supporting Service Operations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Linux infrastructure, observability platforms, infrastructure automation, incident management, and engineering leadership. This individual will partner closely with global engineering and operations teams to reduce toil, improve service reliability, and deliver scalable, resilient solutions that support athenahealth's mission of providing. Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineers based in India. Remain technically hands-on by reviewing designs, guiding implementation efforts, troubleshooting complex issues, and contributing to technical solutions when required. Own team delivery across infrastructure management, observability, service onboarding, alerting, automation, and operational readiness initiatives. Drive observability strategy across metrics, logs, traces, synthetic monitoring, health checks, dashboards, and actionable alerting frameworks. Manage provisioning and lifecycle management of physical and virtual Linux systems using tools such as Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, and related automation platforms. Partner with engineering teams operating within Saa S, hybrid cloud, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS environments to ensure complete monitoring and operational coverage. Identify, measure, and reduce operational toil through automation, self-service capabilities, documentation, and scalable operational processes. Lead Agile delivery practices including sprint planning, backlog prioritization, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement activities. Build and enhance monitoring integrations across platforms including New Relic, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Open Search, Grafana, Icinga, Unified Assurance, and related technologies. Establish Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C), Configuration-as-Code, Monitoring-as-Code, and Alerting-as-Code standards and practices. Improve alert quality by ensuring alerts contain actionable context, ownership, severity levels, routing information, and runbook references. Partner with NOC and Service Operations teams to standardize service onboarding, escalation management, operational handoffs, and response workflows. Manage hiring, onboarding, performance management, feedback, career development, and technical growth of direct reports. Participate in incident response activities, escalation reviews, post-incident analysis, and on-call planning processes. Develop and report operational metrics including alert quality, automation coverage, service health, onboarding throughput, toil reduction, and reliability improvements. Ensure operational excellence through comprehensive documentation, SOPs, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and support procedures while collaborating effectively with global teams. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience will also be considered. 10+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Technical Operations. 2+ years of experience managing or formally leading technical engineering teams. Strong hands-on experience administering, provisioning, and operating Linux systems in large-scale production environments. Proven experience with observability platforms, monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboarding, alerting, and synthetic monitoring solutions. Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Puppet, Ansible, Chef, or similar technologies, along with scripting in Python, Go, Bash, Ruby, Java, or related languages. Experience supporting Saa S, hybrid cloud, Kubernetes/EKS environments, CI/CD pipelines, incident management, operational readiness, and modern engineering practices, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Expected Education & Experience.
minimumQualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience will also be considered.

title: Implementation Senior Analyst
jobDescription: The Senior Analyst is responsible for leading complex, customer-facing technical projects from discovery through delivery. This role partners closely with clients and internal teams to define scope, shape implementation strategy, manage day-to-day execution, and ensure successful outcomes across multiple concurrent initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong project management and client communication skills with enough technical depth to support data analysis, troubleshooting, and scripting work as needed. This role requires someone who can confidently lead critical customer conversations, manage expectations, navigate ambiguity, and drive progress in a fast-paced environment. The team supports customer-facing technical project delivery, implementation execution, and cross-functional coordination across internal and external stakeholders. Team members work together to manage complex engagements, resolve issues, support delivery quality, and improve customer outcomes. The environment values clear communication, accountability, collaboration, and the ability to move between project management, data analysis, and technical problem-solving as needed. Lead end-to-end technical projects, including discovery, scoping, planning, execution, testing, implementation, and post-go-live support. Own customer-facing project conversations, including strategy sessions, status updates, risk management discussions, issue resolution, and executive-level stakeholder communication. Drive project scoping and strategy by translating customer needs into clear requirements, timelines, deliverables, and execution plans. Manage day-to-day project operations, including timelines, dependencies, action items, escalations, and cross-functional coordination. Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to align on goals, priorities, assumptions, and implementation approach. Analyze and validate data to support project decisions, troubleshoot issues, and confirm successful delivery. Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, validate, reconcile, and analyze data as needed. Develop Python scripts or utilities to streamline analysis, automate repetitive work, or support technical troubleshooting. Identify technical, operational, and data-related risks early and drive mitigation plans. Resolve complex issues involving data discrepancies, workflow mismatches, integration challenges, or process breakdowns. Document project scope, requirements, decisions, risks, and outcomes in a clear and organized manner. Work closely with engineering, product, operations, and client teams to unblock issues and ensure delivery. Manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities while maintaining high-quality execution. Recommend process improvements and contribute to scalable delivery methods and operational excellence. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them navigate technical complexity and make informed implementation decisions. Support onboarding or mentoring of teammates on project process, technical workflows, and best practices. Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, support scripting and troubleshooting, and improve project documentation while applying human judgment to verify outputs. Perform other duties as assigned to support team objectives and customer success. Contribute to process improvements that strengthen delivery consistency and operational excellence. Support collaboration across distributed teams and time zones. Assist in maintaining effective project reporting, tracking, and communication practices. Participate in knowledge sharing and best-practice development across the team. Help support scalable methods for managing complex customer-facing technical work. Expected Education & Experience. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, science, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in technical project management, implementation, healthcare IT, and data migration. Strong experience managing customer-facing technical engagements and critical stakeholder conversations. Proven ability to drive scoping, planning, and strategy for complex technical projects. Hands-on experience managing projects end to end in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in SQL for data querying, validation, reconciliation, and analysis. Experience with Python scripting for automation, data handling, or technical analysis is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently. Comfort working with distributed teams across geographies and time zones. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other standard project or data tools. Experience with Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar tools is a plus. Ability to adapt quickly, operate with urgency, and thrive in a collaborative environment. Experience in US healthcare, health IT, or EHR-related work is required. PMP certification is an added advantage.

title: Senior Data Engineer
jobDescription: You will help move healthcare data into athenahealth systems with accuracy, consistency, and care. In this in-office role, you will design and support data import, migration, transformation, and export processes that help practices transition from legacy EHR environments to athenahealth. You will work across sales, product, and operational teams to support reliable data movement, issue resolution, and validation. This position is based in Chennai, India and reports to the Manager, Data Imports & Migrations. The team works closely with product, implementation, engineering, and operations partners to define migration approaches, create ETL routines, validate data quality, and support export activities. Develop and support ETL workflows that extract, transform, and load data from source systems into athenahealth environments. Write and maintain functions used for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting. Build Python scripts and utilities that support import, migration, and automation activities. Partner with internal teams to define source-to-target mappings, business rules, and migration requirements. Review inbound and outbound data to identify gaps, defects, and transformation issues. Support interoperability workflows using HL7 and FHIR standards. Perform EHI export-related tasks and validate output for completeness and accuracy. Investigate data issues, document findings, and help drive resolution across teams. Maintain technical documentation for processes, dependencies, and validation steps. Use AI to improve productivity in data analysis and development tasks, while applying human review to confirm accuracy and align outputs to the needs of the work. Contribute to process improvements that increase the scalability and repeatability of migration work. Support testing and validation activities for data import and export processes. Participate in project planning, status updates, and issue triage as needed. Help maintain reusable tools, templates, and standards for migration work. Assist with documentation updates and knowledge sharing across the team. Support coordination across product, implementation, operations, and engineering partners. Help identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through automation and better process design. Expected Education & Experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in data engineering, ETL, data migration, or a related technical discipline. Experience working with ETL, SQL, and Python. Experience supporting data imports, conversions, migrations, or similar data movement work. Familiarity with HL7 and FHIR interoperability standards. Experience with EHI Export or related healthcare data export workflows preferred. Experience working with healthcare data, healthcare technology, or implementation-focused teams preferred. Ability to analyze data, identify issues, and document technical results clearly. Ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
minimumQualification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
